# Deliberate breaking API changes CI allows, one per line, copied from the
# oasdiff error or warning (see "apps/library" in AGENTS.md). Empty unless a
# removal is under review.
# FIT-651: Arnold model descriptions. Safe since MIN_APP_VERSION 2.7.2 (FIT-650)
# cut off every build that requires the field.
GET /v1/arnold/models removed the required property `data/models/items/description` from the response with the `200` status
# FIT-762: legacy-only muscle groups. Safe since MIN_APP_VERSION 2.9.0 (FIT-759)
# cut off every build that reads those values.
GET /v1/muscle-groups/{muscleGroup} removed the enum value `abs` from the `path` request parameter `muscleGroup`
GET /v1/muscle-groups/{muscleGroup} removed the enum value `cardio` from the `path` request parameter `muscleGroup`
GET /v1/muscle-groups/{muscleGroup} removed the enum value `full-body` from the `path` request parameter `muscleGroup`
GET /v1/muscle-groups/{muscleGroup} removed the enum value `lats` from the `path` request parameter `muscleGroup`
GET /v1/muscle-groups/{muscleGroup} removed the enum value `obliques` from the `path` request parameter `muscleGroup`
